notes.title: The game will become free to play!
notes.notes:
Dear players, unknowingly, it has been over 3 years since the release of<One More Round>
Many players have pointed out the problems with the game, and there are also many players who like it and provide encouragement and support
Although I have experienced many hardships, I have also left behind many beautiful memories
Now, my second self-propelled chess game, Chaos Pioneer, has also been launched on Steam for only 6 yuan
I have decided to turn<another round>into a free game,
Welcome all friends who enjoy self paced chess and rouge gameplay to give it a try and experience the fun of this game

notes.title: The ultimate version, now released!
notes.notes:
Dear friends, the most important update since the release of the game has finally come to you
More than a year has passed since its release in 2021
At the beginning, the game was still green, full of loopholes and unreasonable places
In the past year or so, he has experienced several updates
He grew up little by little. Despite the bumpy road, he is still getting better and doing his best
Just to be better
This version is the most mature and perfect version of the game after a long time of thinking and trying
It is also my summary of this game for more than a year
I hope you like this version
Let's talk about the updated content
Change of attack mechanism
Now all units will choose the nearest enemy to attack, no longer random attack
When you want to taunt, you will attack the taunting unit first, whether in the front or back row
Can you see which side is the first before the battle starts
This change can enable players to take the initiative in the battlefield, better arrange the layout, and increase the strategic nature of the battle
New mechanism -- Exploring events
You may have some exploration events after the battle, which will have a positive impact on your next actions
such as
Every time you enter the "adventure" room, you will recover HP, enter the "elite" room, and gain attack power enhancement, etc
Your progress will be more unpredictable and strategic
New adventure -- battle
In the "adventure" room, you may encounter a specific enemy, a group of wild animals, or a large group of IMPs. Defeating them will reap more rewards and start subsequent battles
After completing a series of battles, you will have a big gift bag waiting for you
Chess pieces can now be unlocked with achievement points. You will get achievement points in the process of breaking through the pass, and then unlock more chess pieces in the atlas, and then you can
Try a new way
And a lot of balancing modifications
Overall, it weakens some too powerful buff effects and slows down the speed of numerical expansion
Players will have more to think about when fighting
The above is all about the final update. Have a good time
I believe it will be the most fun version ever!

Now, when there is no taunt, the nearest enemy will be attacked first
Now we can see who is the first
The amount of gold coins awarded for later battles has been slightly reduced
In difficult mode, there will be an optional debuff
When the boss battle fails, it is no longer necessary to die. The boss causes 20, 30, 40, 45 damage
Now, in addition to the boss room, there are room rewards and terrain rewards
The button to refresh the room is cancelled
The synthetic strengthening stone after three consecutive days adds + 3 gold coins and + 5 experience. You can choose a higher level unit and a unit of the same level
The unlocking function in the past is cancelled, and achievement points are used to unlock new pieces. Achievement points can be obtained during the game
Taunt: increased hint effect
Terrain bonus's + 2 + 2 has been changed to + 2 HP or + 2 attack power
It is possible to obtain some temporary events after the battle
Added some effects of Adventure (unknown)
The strengthening coupon of the synthetic room becomes 5 gold coins
Several new enemies sometimes appear in the combat room

notes.title: 10-11update
notes.notes:
Sorry to have kept you waiting. This update mainly updates the balance of relics in the game, and fixes some bugs at the same time
Experience required for player upgrade reduced
Effect of some relics increased
Hunting night
Old - all allies + 2 + 2 when there are 4 beasts in the field
New - all allies + 4 + 4 when there are 6 beasts on the field
demon game 
Old - when there are 4 demons on the field, all demons + 4 + 4
New - when there are 6 demons on the field, all demons + 8 + 8
Wealth can enlighten God
Old - gain - 2 combat experience and + 1 gold coins
New - gain - 3 combat experience and + 2 gold coins
Synthetic expertise
Old - extra + 2 + 2 when synthesizing chess pieces
New - additional + 4 + 4 when synthesizing chess pieces
Rapid growth
Old - active use, consume 5 gold coins and gain 10 experience. Each round is limited to 1 time
New - active use, consume 3 gold coins and gain 8 experience. Each round is limited to 1 time
Excellent foundation
Old - when buying a unit without traits, make it + 2 + 2
New - when purchasing a unit without traits, make it + 4 + 4
fire at the target a hundred times without a single miss
Old - all ranged units + 3 attack power
New - all remote units + 4 + 2
I am born rich
Old - before the battle starts, store the gold coins in the piggy bank. Actively Click to return twice the gold coins and it will no longer take effect
New - before the battle starts, store the gold coins in the piggy bank. Actively Click to return 3 times the gold coins and it will no longer take effect
will to fight
Old - when there are 3 / 6 soldiers in the field, all friendly forces + 3 / 6 life
New - when there are 3 / 6 Warriors on the field, all allies + 6 / 9 life
will to fight
Old - when summoning an element, make it + 1 + 1
New - when summoning an element, make it + 2 + 2
降低了解锁新怪物的经验要求,并且个别怪物现在不用解锁直接可以用了
